rules.crosscuts: All syntactically observable violations are retained even when another violation has partition priority; completed nonempty length-finished JSON is inspected but never made valid.
rules.numeric_string: String matching optional ASCII sign, decimal/scientific notation, and outer whitespace; no conversion applied.
rules.duplicates: All JSON objects inspected. Equal finite JSON numbers compare numerically; booleans are distinct from numbers. Object pairs and order retained; conflicting and identical duplicates may coexist.
rules.missing_reference_policy: Fail closed; no guessed case labels or baseline.
rules.subset_policy: Use original corrected scorer's valid case IDs and vectors unchanged. All-zero baseline uses those exact ordered case IDs and full original class order.
rules.completeness_policy: Requiring every planned vector before a full-test primary score is local evaluation policy, separate from the underlying AP/Fmax formulas.
